purpose: Make the durable recursive engine enforce the already-authorized foundation-to-depth evidence/experiment workflow before selecting another model node.
defects_frozen_before_edit: near_match_only and contradicts_premise can spawn executable nodes
only D1-D5 stages exist rather than S1-S11
blocked candidate is dispatched instead of its prerequisite
base research node cannot hand off and halt cleanly
empty emission or MISS_NO_RUNNER can close a stage
staged graph can deliver below target
scalar LADDER_ETA acceptance omits project evidence contract
registry persistence is non-atomic and generic registration overwrites
declared recursion limit unused and no tests import loop package

validation_invariants.V1: only directly_supported findings may emit executable nodes
validation_invariants.V2: contradicts_premise yields REVISION_REQUIRED and emits zero nodes
validation_invariants.V3: S1-S11 are explicit, ordered, and dependency-valid
validation_invariants.V4: blocked specs cannot dispatch; eligible prerequisite specs are preferred
validation_invariants.V5: MISS_NO_RUNNER preserves candidate and returns EXECUTION_REQUIRED
validation_invariants.V6: empty evidence cannot silently complete a stage; explicit unknown/blocked state is required
validation_invariants.V7: best_score < target can never return successful deliver
validation_invariants.V8: score-bearing acceptance requires strict chronology, fold-outside, exact row keys, single-policy/source policy, no lockbox/Dacon action, multiplicity-aware promotion receipt
validation_invariants.V9: contradiction/closure-premise invalidation reopens the affected stage/spec deterministically
validation_invariants.V10: registry save is atomic and deterministic; adjudicated outcomes are not overwritten by bookkeeping misses
validation_invariants.V11: targeted loop tests pass and full suite remains green

forbidden: changes outside loop engine/tests except planning receipts

stop_rule: Stop repair when V1-V12 pass or a compatibility contradiction with persisted registry/checkpoint is found; do not tune any model during this node.
